title: Zephyron system architecture
status: Proposed integration of requested features; interfaces require verification
note: Architecture overview, not a verified pin-level schematic. The camera inference workload is on an external laptop/edge server.
source: Functional concept only: supplied paper and photographs; source measurements and performance claims are not accepted as evidence. Paper §§2.1–2.6 and conclusion; manipulator visible in supplied photographs.

title: Radio control, traction and steering
status: Proposed radio-control architecture; mechanical steering is a separate actuation path
blocks:
Mechanical wheel-angle path
mapping to be documented
note: Four-wheel traction and wheel-angle steering are separate functions. The proposed design must document how steering servos and left/right motor-speed commands are coordinated.
source: Functional concept only: supplied paper and photographs; source measurements and performance claims are not accepted as evidence. Paper §2.1; wheel steering servos visible in source photos.

title: Water-quality screening
status: Proposed sensing flow; calibration is required for quantitative units
note: TDS and turbidity are screening indicators; neither establishes potability or confirms pathogens. Temperature compensation depends on the actual installed sensor system.
source: Functional concept only: supplied paper and photographs; source measurements and performance claims are not accepted as evidence. Paper §2.2 and §3.1. Sensor part numbers and deployed compensation implementation are not confirmed.

title: MQ-2 gas and smoke indication
status: Proposed MQ-2 path; response is not gas-specific identification
note: Cross-sensitivity and environmental drift require calibration. The MQ-2 indicates gas/smoke response; it does not independently verify fire or measure selective CO concentration.
source: Functional concept only: supplied paper and photographs; source measurements and performance claims are not accepted as evidence. Paper §2.3 and §3.2; corrected interpretation of MQ-2 capability.

title: Proposed protected solar power
status: SELECTED DESIGN BASELINE — component ratings, not measured rover performance
blocks:
PV input protection
14.6 V CC–CV charge profile

DC/DC rails selected for
logic, camera and servos
note: Selected component ratings define the proposed electrical interfaces. Charger implementation, delivered solar power, charging time and rover endurance require verification.
source: Selected manufacturer baseline verified in ENG_PANEL (Newpowa NPA20S-12J), ENG_BATTERY (Bioenno BLF-1206A), ENG_BQ24650 and ENG_BQ76920. Charger and pack protection are distinct functions; no rover energy-performance result is claimed.

title: GNSS geolocation and geotagging
status: Proposed GNSS receiver-to-record flow; receiver selection and interfaces to verify
blocks:
Read serial messages
associate valid time / position
note: Position quality depends on sky visibility and receiver state. A nominal GNSS accuracy statement is not a rover localization validation result.
source: Functional concept only: supplied paper and photographs; source measurements and performance claims are not accepted as evidence. Paper §2.5 and §3.4. Serial transfer is a functional module interface, not a verified pin assignment.

source: Functional concept only: supplied paper and photographs; source measurements and performance claims are not accepted as evidence. Paper §3.6 and conclusion mention UV; no module, wiring or calibration method supplied.

title: Geiger–Müller radiation screening
status: Proposed GM sensing flow; detector module and calibration remain to be specified
blocks:
Count pulses over
a defined time interval

Count rate / record
dose only after calibration
note: A generic GM count rate is not a calibrated dose rate. Tube type, background, measurement interval and calibration must be documented before dose-unit claims.
source: Functional concept only: supplied paper and photographs; source measurements and performance claims are not accepted as evidence. Paper introduction and conclusion identify GM sensing without an implemented module or validation protocol.

title: Obstacle sensing with manual supervision
status: Proposed supervised avoidance; command-arbitration behavior requires implementation
note: The source characterizes autonomy as teleoperation with basic avoidance. This figure does not imply autonomous mapping, route planning or validated obstacle safety.
source: Functional concept only: supplied paper and photographs; source measurements and performance claims are not accepted as evidence. Paper introduction, conclusion and final limitations; detailed arbitration algorithm not supplied.

title: Video streaming and external object detection
status: Proposed processing location — object detection runs on an external host
note: The camera supplies frames to an external detector. Model classes, latency, precision and recall must be established through separate experiments on the selected hardware.
source: Functional concept only: supplied paper and photographs; source measurements and performance claims are not accepted as evidence. Paper §2.6 and §3.7; ESP32-CAM → Wi-Fi → external inference server is explicit.

recorded video files

source: Functional concept only: supplied paper and photographs; source measurements and performance claims are not accepted as evidence. Paper §2.6 and §3.7 name firmware and recording / streaming features.

title: IoT telemetry and Blynk supervision
